b1-onkormanyzat-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Local Self-Government
b1-onkormanyzat-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about local government.
b1-onkormanyzat-01.prompt: Say who decides local public affairs and how many districts Budapest has.
cues: Say how many districts Budapest has
b1-onkormanyzat-01.target: A helyi közügyekről a helyi közösség dönt. Budapestnek huszonhárom kerülete van.
b1-onkormanyzat-01.english: The local community decides local public affairs. Budapest has twenty-three districts.
b1-onkormanyzat-01.canDo: I can explain municipal autonomy and self-governance in Hungary.

b1-onkormanyzat-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Mayor and the Clerk
b1-onkormanyzat-02.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the mayor and the town hall.
b1-onkormanyzat-02.prompt: Say for how many years the mayor is elected and who is responsible for the office.
cues: Say for how long the mayor is elected
Say who is responsible for the office
b1-onkormanyzat-02.target: A polgármestert öt évre választják meg. A hivatalért a jegyző felel.
b1-onkormanyzat-02.english: The mayor is elected for five years. The town clerk is responsible for the office.
b1-onkormanyzat-02.canDo: I can describe the election and powers of the mayor and Lord Mayor.

b1-onkormanyzat-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Counties
b1-onkormanyzat-03.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the counties.
b1-onkormanyzat-03.prompt: Say how many counties Hungary has and name a city with county rights.
cues: Name a city with county rights
b1-onkormanyzat-03.target: Magyarországnak tizenkilenc megyéje van. Debrecen megyei jogú város.
b1-onkormanyzat-03.english: Hungary has nineteen counties. Debrecen is a city with county rights.
b1-onkormanyzat-03.canDo: I can say that Hungary has nineteen counties plus the capital.

b1-onkormanyzat-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Government Window
b1-onkormanyzat-04.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the offices that deal with citizens.
b1-onkormanyzat-04.prompt: Say where citizens can arrange their official affairs and who heads the county government office.
cues: Say where citizens arrange their affairs
Say who heads the county office
b1-onkormanyzat-04.target: Az állampolgárok a kormányablakban intézhetik az ügyeiket. A megyei kormányhivatalt a kormánymegbízott vezeti.
b1-onkormanyzat-04.english: Citizens can arrange their affairs at the government window. The county government office is headed by the government commissioner.
b1-onkormanyzat-04.canDo: I can distinguish elected self-governments from central state administrative offices.

b1-onkormanyzat-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Local Democracy
b1-onkormanyzat-05.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about local democracy.
b1-onkormanyzat-05.prompt: Say that the council holds a public hearing every year and that residents can start a local referendum.
cues: Say what the council holds every year
b1-onkormanyzat-05.target: A képviselő-testület évente közmeghallgatást tart. A lakosok helyi népszavazást kezdeményezhetnek.
b1-onkormanyzat-05.english: The council holds a public hearing every year. Residents can initiate a local referendum.
b1-onkormanyzat-05.canDo: I can identify essential municipal services: water, lighting, waste, kindergartens.

b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Runs the Town
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about local government.
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.prompt: Say who leads the municipality and who is responsible for the office.
cues: Say who is responsible for the office
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.target: A települést a polgármester és a képviselő-testület vezeti. A hivatalért a jegyző felel.
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.english: The mayor and the council lead the municipality. The town clerk is responsible for the office.
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.canDo: I can explain how Hungarian local government and public administration work.
